# Chapter 12 — Neural Network Report

## 1. Digits (1,797 images, 64 pixels, 10 classes)

| Model | Test accuracy |
|---|---|
| Logistic regression | 0.956 |
| MLP 64→128→64→10, dropout 0.2 | 0.978 |

Best validation epoch: 104 of 124 run (17,226 parameters).

## 2. California Housing (20,640 rows, 8 features)

| Model | Test RMSE ($100k) | Test R² |
|---|---|---|
| Linear regression | 0.746 | 0.576 |
| MLP, raw inputs | 0.699 | 0.628 |
| MLP, standardised inputs | 0.531 | 0.785 |

## 3. Diabetes (442 rows; 282 used for training)

| Model | Test RMSE | Test R² |
|---|---|---|
| Linear regression | 53.9 | 0.453 |
| MLP 256→256, 500 epochs, no regularisation | 56.3 | 0.401 |
| Same MLP, early stopping + dropout + weight decay | 53.0 | 0.469 |

Overfit run: validation loss bottomed at epoch 196 (MSE 2,979); after 500 epochs training MSE was 762 and validation MSE 3,888.
Early-stopped run kept epoch 124 (stopped after 144).
